_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”) to residential and business customers in the United States' (FY2010 10-K); 'On January 28, 2011, we closed our transaction with General Electric Company (“GE”) in which we acquired control of the businesses of NBC Universal'; 'Competition for the cable services we offer primarily includes direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'

classification.quality_note: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”) to residential and business customers in the United States' (FY2010 10-K); 'On January 28, 2011, we closed our transaction with General Electric Company (“GE”) in which we acquired control of the businesses of NBC Universal'; 'Competition for the cable services we offer primarily includes direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.09x; -6% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.31; conservative 2yr +92%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.2%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.3-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +29.3%/yr (FY04-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2011-04-15) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.09x (42.8% downside to Bear $14 / +496.2% upside to Bull $146) | Adj composite 2.38 vs market 1.06: gap +1.31 [UNDERVALUED] | -7% above the EPP floor $26 (20x FY11E $1.31) | Conservative 2-yr case: +91.8% total (+45.9%/yr) | At 18.7x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $32 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -3.2% in Q4 2010, forward revenues +7.2% (no FY11 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2010 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Comcast FY2010 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2006-2010; diluted shares 2,820M, 2,885M, 2,952M; video customers 2006-2010; segment revenues; the $0.45 planned annual dividend; the NBCUniversal transaction closed on January 28, 2011

sources.title: Comcast Q4 2010 earnings release (8-K, Exhibit 99.1)
sources.supports: Q4 and full-year 2010 statement of operations; EPS excluding the NBCUniversal transaction costs and non-recurring items, 2010 $1.31 and 2009 $1.11 (GAAP $1.29 and $1.26); video customers; the dividend raised to $0.1125 a quarter

sources.title: Comcast FY2009 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2005-2009 (revenues reclassified for advertising commissions; diluted EPS from continuing operations $1.26, $0.86, $0.83, $0.70, $0.25); diluted shares 2,885M, 2,952M, 3,129M; video customers 2005-2009; segment revenues; the $0.378 planned annual dividend

sources.title: Comcast FY2008 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2004-2008; consolidated statement of operations 2006-2008; diluted shares 3,180M, 3,129M, 2,952M; capital expenditures; video customers 2004-2008; segment revenues

sources.title: Comcast Q4 2008 earnings release (8-K, Exhibit 99.1)
sources.supports: Q4 and full-year 2008 statement of operations; Adjusted EPS 2008 $0.91 and 2007 $0.74; video customers; quarterly dividend raised to $0.0675; no 2009 outlook in numbers

sources.title: Comcast Q4 2007 earnings release (8-K, Exhibit 99.1)
sources.supports: Q4 and full-year 2007 statement of operations; Adjusted EPS 2007 $0.74 and 2006 $0.60; 2008 Financial Outlook (consolidated revenue growth of 8% to 10%); first quarterly dividend of $0.0625

sources.title: Comcast 8-K: three-for-two stock split
